name: Mei Lin
bio:
Mei Lin's culinary journey began in her family's restaurant in Chengdu, where she learned the art of Sichuan cuisine from a young age. After years of honing her skills and gaining a deep understanding of flavor profiles, she sought a new challenge, finding her way into the fast-paced world of motorsport catering.

Joining GCK Motorsport was a dream come true for Mei. She prides herself on providing nutritious and delicious meals to the team, understanding the importance of proper sustenance for peak performance. Her approach is rooted in meticulous planning and a commitment to using fresh, high-quality ingredients. Mei is known for her innovative fusion dishes, blending traditional Chinese flavors with international culinary techniques, keeping the team energized and excited for every race.

Her dedication extends beyond the kitchen. Mei’s adaptable nature allows her to seamlessly adjust to the changing demands of the race schedule and dietary needs of each team member. Her ability to create a comforting and supportive environment through her culinary expertise makes her an invaluable asset to GCK Motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, with a neatly tied back section
physical.description: Mei is a petite woman with a warm smile and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small pouch of Sichuan peppercorns.
Refers to the team members as her 'racing family'.
Insists on brewing a pot of strong jasmine tea every afternoon at 3 pm.
